'''Dentani Starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was in operation during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], after defeating the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Desh (Imperial)|Desh]] in a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] game the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Ulicx Vinaq]] planned to depart from Dentani Starport.<ref name="Sore Loser">{{WEGCite|story=Sore Loser|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
